concepts.label: Click ID
concepts.description: The ID the tracking platform gives a click. It travels to the advertiser in the offer URL and comes back on the conversion postback.

concepts.label: Partner click ID
concepts.description: The click ID of the affiliate or traffic source, echoed back to them in the outgoing postback.

concepts.label: Sub ID
concepts.description: Free-form values the sender attaches to a click and gets back on the conversion.

concepts.label: Payout or revenue
concepts.description: Money for the conversion: what the receiver earns or what the sender reports.

concepts.label: Sale amount
concepts.description: The order value of the sale behind the conversion.

concepts.label: Currency
concepts.description: Currency code of the amount.

concepts.label: Status
concepts.description: Conversion state, such as approved, pending, declined or reversed.

concepts.label: Transaction ID
concepts.description: A unique ID for the conversion or reward, used to process it once.

concepts.label: Event or goal
concepts.description: Which step of a multi-event offer the conversion belongs to.

concepts.label: Offer ID
concepts.description: ID of the offer or campaign that converted.

concepts.label: Campaign ID
concepts.description: ID of the tracker campaign.

concepts.label: Affiliate ID
concepts.description: ID of the affiliate or partner.

concepts.label: IP address
concepts.description: The user's IP address.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: The user's country.

concepts.label: Time
concepts.description: Time of the click or conversion.

concepts.label: Security
concepts.description: A token, secret or signature that proves the request is genuine.

concepts.label: User ID
concepts.description: The publisher's own user ID, passed into the offerwall and returned on the postback.

concepts.label: Reward
concepts.description: The reward in the publisher's virtual currency.

concepts.label: Currency name
concepts.description: Name of the publisher's virtual currency.

concepts.label: Offer name
concepts.description: Name of the offer.

concepts.label: Other
concepts.description: A documented parameter that does not fit the concepts above.

tracking_platforms.name: BeMob

macros.note: Unique per conversion, for example an order number.

tracking_platforms.name: RedTrack

Whitelist IP records conversions only from a given IP or range.
